description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OEE"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/oee">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OEE" name="Process started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Measure_Merge" name="Measurement cycle" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Continue_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OEE_Acceptable</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectData" name="Collect information from machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_Calculate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_Calculate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Calculate_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEE_Split" name="OEE below threshold?" default="Flow_OEE_Acceptable" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Calculate_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OEE_Below</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OEE_Acceptable</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_StopMachine" name="Stop machine and send email to engineer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OEE_Below</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Subprocess_Restart</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StopMachine" name="Halt required">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stop_Start_Task</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StopMachine" name="Stop machine">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stop_Start_Task</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stop_Email</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmail" name="Send email to engineer">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stop_Email</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Email_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineStopped" name="Machine stopped">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Email_End</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_Start_Task" sourceRef="StartEvent_StopMachine" targetRef="Task_StopMachine"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_Email" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Task_SendEmail"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_End" sourceRef="Task_SendEmail" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineStopped"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_Restarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Subprocess_Restart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Restarted_Continue</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Restarted" messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ContinueMeasuring" name="Continue measuring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Restarted_Continue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Continue_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" isInterrupting="true">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disconnect_End</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Disconnected" messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessStopped" name="Process stopped">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disconnect_End</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition id="TED_Stopped"/>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnect_End" sourceRef="StartEvent_Disconnected" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessStopped"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Merge" sourceRef="StartEvent_OEE" targetRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Continue_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ContinueMeasuring" targetRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Collect" sourceRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge" targetRef="Task_CollectData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Calculate" sourceRef="Task_CollectData" targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calculate_Split" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE" targetRef="Gateway_OEE_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_Below" name="OEE below threshold" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Split" targetRef="SubProcess_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>OEE below threshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_Acceptable" name="OEE at or above threshold" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Subprocess_Restart" sourceRef="SubProcess_StopMachine" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Restarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restarted_Continue" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_Restarted" targetRef="Task_ContinueMeasuring"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
